reply.text:
Fifteen pounds in a week isn't something I'll coach you toward. The only ways to chase that are crash dieting, cutting water, or starving yourself, and they leave you flat, dizzy and worse off in the photos. Please talk it through with a doctor or a registered dietitian before doing anything drastic.

What does work in a week is the stuff that helps you look and feel sharp. Sleep well, drink water normally, eat regular meals with plenty of protein, and keep your training steady without adding anything new that leaves you sore on the day. If you want, I can set up a short session or two for this week so you walk in feeling strong.

Congratulations, by the way.
